## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results.

- [ ] Client lint, typecheck, unit tests, and build pass.
- [ ] Browser integration and fixture tests pass.
- [ ] Backend tests and jar build pass when applicable.
- [ ] Documentation is updated in English.
- [ ] No secrets, logs, screenshots, build outputs, or machine paths are included.
- [ ] Apache-2.0, `LICENSE`, `NOTICE`, and attributions are preserved.
- [ ] Default scoring, `scoreCap: 0.6`, and F1-F5/F4b are unchanged unless explicitly approved.
- [ ] Benchmark deviations and post-measurement code changes are disclosed.
